item.summary: Huddlestock Fintech AS has entered into a partnership agreement with Firi AS for a tied-agent solution under Huddlestock's MiFID II framework. Firi will itself communicate the scope and timing of new services. The commercial terms are a fixed monthly fee plus a volume-based fee, and the agreement is subject to customary regulatory notifications. The deal follows the letter of intent published on 21 November.
